knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to estimate time from the scope, counting rooms, surfaces, methods and drying time. The price (option 0) and the worker's mood (option 2) are not the basis.

The lesson says to tell the next customer early with a revised time the team can meet. Saying nothing and rushing (option 0) and promising the original time anyway (option 2) lead to rushed work or broken promises.
The plan the route and the day section says to keep a buffer for delay between jobs, and to plan the day around travel, access windows and breaks.

practicalCriteria: Learner estimates the time for a supplied scope by counting rooms, surfaces, method, drying and set-up, and records the basis.
Learner plans a supplied day's route with travel, access windows and a delay buffer, and the plan matches the access times given.
Learner tells the next customer of a simulated overrun early, with a revised time that the plan can meet.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Schedule record with estimates, planned times and actual times
Record of any change to a planned time and the reason
stopWorkCriteria: Learner shortens drying, contact or set-up times to meet a planned time
